summary: Masumi describes identity verification for the GWI audience-insight agent on Sokosumi. This is a potential commercial audience-data integration; public data access and a MEW partnership are not established.
Masumi announces MCP access to Sokosumi services. Repository and authentication compatibility require separate testing before MEW can dispatch jobs.
Masumi describes monetizing n8n workflows and their payment and job lifecycle. MEW should retain its own durable operation identity and reconcile uncertain outcomes.
